rules.stable_vs_dynamic: Canonical place identity and administrative hierarchy may be stable while access, schedules, border status and road condition are dynamic.
rules.geometry_provenance: Every point, line or polygon must carry original source, source layer, CRS/reference system, geometry type and retrieval date before Atlas publication.
rules.road_projects: Never convert a road project or penetration road into a completed public through-route without current official evidence.
rules.transport_scope: Operator route scope or terminal authorization does not prove fixed-frequency service.
rules.subsidized_transport: Do not present isolated-zone subsidized transport as a normal tourism product.
rules.shared_entities: Reuse identical IDs such as puerto_williams across graphs to allow controlled graph federation.
